q14.

`ShortcutService` has five RPCs, all implemented in a single backend file, `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`.

**RPC names** (defined in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`, lines 14–52):

- `ListShortcuts` — `GET /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`, returns `ListShortcutsResponse`
- `GetShortcut` — `GET /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`, returns `Shortcut`
- `CreateShortcut` — `POST /api/v1/{parent=users/*}/shortcuts`, returns `Shortcut`
- `UpdateShortcut` — `PATCH /api/v1/{shortcut.name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`, returns `Shortcut`
- `DeleteShortcut` — `DELETE /api/v1/{name=users/*/shortcuts/*}`, returns `google.protobuf.Empty`

**Implementing file:** `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`, where each RPC is a method on `*APIV1Service` — `ListShortcuts` (line 49), `GetShortcut` (line 95), `CreateShortcut` (line 135), `UpdateShortcut` (line 211), and `DeleteShortcut` (line 284). The same file also holds two unexported helpers that are not RPCs: `extractUserAndShortcutIDFromName` (line 22) and `validateFilter` (line 336).

For completeness, the generated (non-hand-written) plumbing for this service lives in `proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service.pb.go`, `proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service_grpc.pb.go`, `proto/gen/api/v1/shortcut_service.pb.gw.go`, and `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/shortcut_service.connect.go`, with tests in `server/router/api/v1/test/shortcut_service_test.go`.
